Class GameSnapshot

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.snapshot.GameSnapshot
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameSnapshot extends Object implements Serializable
Serializable, immutable snapshot of the whole game state at a given instant. It is the root of the snapshot tree and aggregates the player context, the board and the current phase, together with scalar metadata such as the game id, the number of players and the current turn.

Snapshots are produced when persisting a game and consumed when restoring it after a crash, so that the full game can be reconstructed from disk.
